title.value: Technology-enhanced trauma training in low-resource settings: A scoping review and feasibility analysis of educational technologies
title.justification: The paper's title indicates that it focuses on evaluating the feasibility of educational technologies for trauma training in low-resource settings.
title.quote: Technology-enhanced trauma training in low-resource settings: A scoping review and feasibility analysis of educational technologies

extractions.description: This paper reviews current educational technologies used in trauma training courses and evaluates their feasibility for implementation in low- and lower-middle-income countries (LMICs). It conducts a scoping review of 64 articles to assess the learning outcomes from technology-enhanced training in general trauma assessment, team skills, and procedures as defined by the 2020 Advanced Trauma Life Support® program. The study uses Technology-Enhanced Learning criteria to analyze the feasibility of these technologies in the context of LMICs, considering factors like production, maintenance, cost, and reusability.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper revolves around educational technologies for trauma training in low-resource settings and does not directly address climate change.
climate_change_is_central.quote: This study reviews current technologies used in trauma courses and evaluates their feasibility for LMICs. It is the first study to perform a feasibility analysis of trauma training technologies in the LMIC context.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not directly relate to any climate change categories, instead focusing on healthcare education in low-resource settings.
primary_category.quote: This study reviews current technologies used in trauma courses and evaluates their feasibility for LMICs. It is the first study to perform a feasibility analysis of trauma training technologies in the LMIC context.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not fit into any specific sub-category of climate change.
primary_sub_category.quote: Despite their effectiveness, high-fidelity mannequins ranked poorly in production, maintenance, cost, and reusability categories, therefore being poorly suited for LMICs.

new_primary_category.justification: This new category captures the paper's focus on the adaptation and feasibility of educational technologies for medical training in low-income and resource-constrained environments, a concept not covered under the predefined climate change categories.
new_primary_category.quote: The lack of adequately trained staff is often cited as a contributor to this problem, especially in LMICs. This study reviews current technologies used in trauma courses and evaluates their feasibility for LMICs.

new_primary_sub_category.value: Scoping review and feasibility analysis of educational technologies
new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper conducts a scoping review and feasibility analysis specifically on the use of educational technologies for trauma training in low-resource settings, which is not covered under the existing sub-categories.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We conducted a scoping review evaluating the learning outcomes of technology-enhanced training in general trauma assessment, team skills or any procedures covered in the 2020 Advanced Trauma Life Support® program.
